front.name: front
front.note: front elevation of the PILOT yoke looking forward: (u, h), u outboard = sheet left -- yoke-local mm
front.formula: sheet_mm = A @ (a, b) + t; (a, b) = (y, z)

side.name: side
side.note: side elevation from outboard (port for the pilot yoke), nose left: (a, h) -- yoke-local mm
side.formula: sheet_mm = A @ (a, b) + t; (a, b) = (x, z)

top.name: top
top.note: from above, forward up: (u, a), u outboard = left -- yoke-local mm
top.formula: sheet_mm = A @ (a, b) + t; (a, b) = (x, y)

sec_B.name: sec_B
sec_B.note: section B-B at h 48 from above, (u, a), forward up, outboard left -- yoke-local mm
sec_B.formula: sheet_mm = A @ (a, b) + t; (a, b) = (x, y)
